tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What BioRobot does, the service area, transparent pricing, and how to order. Call this first.

tools.name: get_estimate
tools.description: Price estimate for a BioRobot task from distance and time. Formula: $25 base + $100/hr (15-min increments) + $0.70/mile round trip from ZIP 60014, $40 minimum.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether a US ZIP code is inside BioRobot's 50-mile service area around Crystal Lake, IL 60014.

tools.name: submit_task
tools.description: Submit a task order to BioRobot. A human reviews every request before acceptance — no work starts until scope, price, and proof requirements are agreed. Use get_estimate and check_service_area first when unsure.
